subtitle: UPDATE Aug 14, 51 days from the first round. PRICE: there is a new reading for the presidential market, confirmed reading of Aug 14, 14:46 BRT (17:46 UTC). For the second and third place contracts, for the Senate and for the STF impeachment contract there is no new reading on Aug 14, and the values displayed are those of the last confirmed reading, from Aug 12, 16:41 BRT. POLLS: Quaest releases a national poll today with 13 candidates tested, and at the time of this capture the results had not yet been published, so PoderData/Aya of Aug 13 remains in force (n=2,400, telephone, fieldwork Aug 9 to Aug 12, BR-06868/2026). ELECTORAL REGISTRY: on the night of Aug 13 the TSE suspended the processing of new affiliations in the Filia system, according to Gazeta do Povo and Brasil de Fato, and the court itself stated that there was NO hacking, but rather improper use of the tool by someone holding the party's credentials. On Aug 13 Nunes Marques restored the PL affiliation and cleared the registration, and Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy was registered hours later, according to Brasil de Fato on Aug 14. The registration deadline closes on Aug 15.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE WITH A NEW READING ON Aug 14: 63.50% (vol USD 8.25M cumulative), the same value as the confirmed reading of Aug 12. It is the sixth consecutive day at 63.50% in the recorded series. POLLS: PoderData/Aya of Aug 13 remains in force, with 41% in the first round and 46% x 45% in the runoff, because the Quaest poll of today had no published result at the time of capture.
fortes: His price is the steadiest in the presidential book in this window: 63.50% in every recorded reading from Aug 9 to Aug 14, six days without variation.
He leads or ties the first round in the EIGHT national polls since Aug 5, and wins the runoff in five of the six rounds that test it.
CNT/MDA of Aug 11 remains his best reading of the window: 42.4% in the first round, with a 13.7pp lead, and 48% x 39% in the runoff.
The attempt identified by the TSE targeted his PT affiliation and was never completed, according to Gazeta do Povo and Brasil de Fato. His party registration was not changed.
The cumulative volume of his contract rose to USD 8.25M, and he remains among the three most traded names in the presidential book.
fracos: The distance to the runner-up narrowed by 0.20pp since the last confirmed reading, from 35.85pp on Aug 12 to 35.65pp today, and the one who moved was his opponent.
PoderData of Aug 13 shows the runoff at 1pp, the tightest value the house has ever given him in its own series, after 3pp on Jul 30.
Personal approval at 43% against 50% disapproval in PoderData of Aug 13, a net 7pp negative.
Rejection at 48%, exactly equal to his opponent's, which blocks any easy reading about who has more room to grow.
He ties in the runoff with Caiado and with Zema in PoderData of Aug 13, and neither of them goes above 5.7% in the first round in any house in the window.
candidates.analise: THE PRICE HAS A READING AGAIN AND IT DID NOT MOVE. On Aug 14 he stands at 63.50% (vol USD 8.25M cumulative), the same value as the confirmed reading of Aug 12, and the recorded series shows 63.50% on every day from Aug 9 to Aug 14. Six days without variation in a contract of this volume is information, and what it says is that the market did not react to anything that happened during the week. The distance to the runner-up narrowed by 0.20pp over the period, and the movement was entirely his opponent's, not the leader's. In the polls nothing has changed since yesterday, because the Quaest poll of today had no published figure when this page was assembled, and PoderData/Aya of Aug 13 remains in force, with 41% in the first round and 46% x 45% in the runoff. The fact of the day about him is of another nature and comes from the TSE: the court identified an attempt to change his party affiliation, within the same episode that hit his opponent, and suspended the processing of new affiliations. The attempt was blocked and his PT registration did not change.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE WITH A NEW READING ON Aug 14: 27.85% (vol USD 8.20M cumulative). The price went from 27.65% on Aug 12 to 27.85% now, a rise of 0.20pp. He was the only one in the leading pack to rise. REGISTRY: Nunes Marques restored his PL affiliation on Aug 13 and cleared the registration, and his presidential candidacy was registered hours later, according to Brasil de Fato and Gazeta do Povo.
fortes: The only name above 1% to rise between the reading of Aug 12 and that of Aug 14, up 0.20pp, and the movement of the gap over the period was entirely his.
Gerp of Aug 11 remains the first national poll of the window to put him ahead in the runoff, with 45% against 43%.
In PoderData of Aug 13 he rose from 43% to 45% in the runoff against his own house, ending 1pp from the leader, inside the 2pp margin.
His PL affiliation was restored by a decision of Nunes Marques on Aug 13 and his presidential candidacy was registered hours later, according to Brasil de Fato and Gazeta do Povo.
Rejection at 48% in PoderData of Aug 13, exactly equal to the leader's.
fracos: Even with the rise, he is 35.65pp behind the leader on price, and the series recorded since May 16 shows 51 points at a level equal to or above today's 27.85%.
The peak of his series remains 33.20%, measured on Jun 2 at 19:30, well above today's value.
The registration of his presidential candidacy by the PL was blocked by a records problem he did not cause, and the deadline closes on Aug 15, with no slack.
In the first round he repeated his own house's 35% in PoderData, with no gain between Jul 30 and Aug 13.
The spread between houses on him remains above 9pp in the window, from 28.7% at CNT/MDA to 38% at Gerp, double the dispersion measured on the leader.
candidates.analise: 🔴 THE FACT OF THE DAY ABOUT HIM CAME OUT OF THE ELECTORAL REGISTRY AND BECAME A SYSTEM-WIDE CASE. Yesterday Folha de S.Paulo and G1 reported that he appeared in the TSE records affiliated with Missão, the party of Renan Santos, without his knowledge, and that this blocked the formal registration of his candidacy by the PL. On Aug 14 the outcome has two parts. The first is individual: Nunes Marques restored the PL affiliation on Aug 13 and cleared the registration, and his presidential candidacy was registered hours later, according to Brasil de Fato. The second is larger than him: on the night of Aug 13 the TSE suspended the processing of new affiliations in the Filia system, and the court itself stated that there was NO hacking, but rather improper use of the tool by someone holding the party's credentials, after also identifying an attempt to change the leader's affiliation that was never completed, according to Gazeta do Povo. The candidate registration deadline closes on Aug 15. On price, he is the only name above 1% that rose since the last confirmed reading, up 0.20pp to 27.85% (vol USD 8.20M cumulative), and the entire 0.20pp reduction in the distance to the leader came from him. Series caveat: among the points recorded since May 16, 51 had a value equal to or above today's, with a peak of 33.20% on Jun 2.

candidates.name: Renan Santos
candidates.header: PRICE WITH A NEW READING ON Aug 14: 7.15% (vol USD 9.59M cumulative). The price went from 7.45% on Aug 12 to 7.15% now, a fall of 0.30pp. It was the largest fall in the leading pack in this reading. He still holds the largest cumulative volume in the presidential book among names above 1%.
fortes: He holds the largest cumulative volume in the presidential book among names above 1%, at USD 9.59M, above the contracts of the leader and the runner-up.
His price remains BETWEEN the two polling methods, above the 4% to 5% of telephone and in-person and below the 10% of Palver online.
His party, Missão, ended up at the centre of the TSE records case without the party being named as the author, and Gazeta do Povo published his government programme this week.
He remains the only name outside the top two with a price above 5% in the presidential book.
Palver, online, is the only national poll of the window to give him double digits, at 10%, and the house itself declared the method caveat.
fracos: He fell 0.30pp since the last confirmed reading, the largest fall among names above 1%.
He is the only one in the pack whom the leader BEATS in the runoff of PoderData of Aug 13, according to Bnews, while tying with the other three.
In telephone and in-person national polls he sits between 4% and 5%, below what the price assigns him.
His first-round percentages in PoderData of Aug 13 did not appear in the reports captured, so the most recent reading on him is still from Aug 11.

The party he is running for is the same one in which the PL candidate appeared affiliated without his knowledge, an episode the TSE treated as fraud and which led to the suspension of the affiliation system.
candidates.analise: HE HAD THE LARGEST FALL IN THE LEADING PACK IN THIS READING. The price went from 7.45% on Aug 12 to 7.15% on Aug 14, a retreat of 0.30pp, while the leader stayed put and the runner-up rose. His cumulative volume is still the largest in the presidential book among names above 1%, at USD 9.59M, which keeps the contract well backed despite the retreat. In the polls, the most recent reading on him is still that of Aug 11, because his first-round percentages in PoderData of Aug 13 did not appear in the reports captured. What PoderData did show was the runoff scenario, and there he is the only one of the four tested whom the leader beats, according to Bnews, while Caiado, Zema and the runner-up all tie. The method effect remains the central reading on him: the same name runs from 4% on telephone and in person to 10% online, and the caveat was declared by Palver itself. The price remains positioned between the two methods.

caiado.label: CAIADO (PSD), presidential Poly 1.05% (vol USD 5.70M cumulative, confirmed reading of Aug 14, 14:46 BRT (17:46 UTC)), up 0.10pp since Aug 12 | TIES with the leader in the runoff of PoderData of Aug 13 | polls in force: Gerp 4%, Genial/Quaest 4%, Meio/Ideia 5.7%, BTG/Nexus 5%
caiado.fortes: He is the only one in the pack with a new price reading on Aug 14, and it is a rise: 1.05%. The price went from 0.95% on Aug 12 to 1.05% now. HE TIES WITH THE LEADER IN THE RUNOFF of PoderData of Aug 13, according to CNN Brasil and Bnews, his second tie in four days after the BTG/Nexus one of Aug 10. In the polls he has 4% to 5.7% in the first round depending on the house, ahead of the other names in the pack.
caiado.fracos: Even with the rise, his winning price remains at 1.05%, against 4% to 5.7% of declared intention in the first round. The distance between polls and price is still the largest in the pack in this window. Tying in the runoff and winning the election are different questions, and the panel does not add them together.

haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), presidential Poly 0.15% (vol USD 7.06M cumulative, last confirmed reading, from Aug 12, 16:41 BRT), no new reading on Aug 14 because he is below the 0.5% cutoff | NOT tested by the national polls in force, because he is running for the governorship of São Paulo
haddad.fortes: His cumulative volume is still larger than that of several names priced above him, which keeps the contract with trading backing despite the low price.
haddad.fracos: PoderData of Aug 13 does not test him, and no national poll of the window includes him in a presidential scenario. The underlying caveat remains and must be stated clearly: he is NOT a presidential candidate, he is running for the governorship of São Paulo, and any scenario that includes him is a polling hypothesis, not a candidacy under way.

zema.label: ZEMA (Novo), presidential Poly 0.35% (vol USD 5.07M cumulative, last confirmed reading, from Aug 12, 16:41 BRT), no new reading on Aug 14 because he is below the 0.5% cutoff | TIES with the leader in the runoff of PoderData of Aug 13 | polls in force: Gerp 2%, Genial/Quaest 2%, Meio/Ideia 2.6%, BTG/Nexus 3%

He remains the only one in the pack with a candidacy registration already filed with the TSE, done on Aug 6 with R$ 178.7 million declared, which keeps him out of the squeeze of the deadline closing on Aug 15.

In the polls he runs from 2% to 3% in the first round, the narrowest band in the pack, and the distance between tying in the runoff and reaching the runoff is exactly what those figures do not cover.

candidates.analise: ⭐ THE PACK'S CONTRAST STILL STANDS, AND TODAY IT GAINED A NEW DATA POINT ON THE PRICE SIDE. Caiado is the only one in the group with a new reading on Aug 14 and he ROSE, from 0.95% to 1.05% (vol USD 5.70M cumulative). It is a small movement in absolute terms, but he is the second name on the panel to move upward in this reading, alongside the runner-up. In the polls nothing changed since yesterday: PoderData of Aug 13 remains the national poll in force, and in it Caiado and Zema TIE with the leader in the runoff, according to CNN Brasil and Bnews. For Caiado it is the second tie in four days, after the BTG/Nexus one of Aug 10; for Zema it is the first of the window. The distance between the two instruments remains the finding: 4% to 5.7% of declared intention in the first round against a little over 1% of winning price. ⚠️ The two measure different questions, tying in the runoff and winning the election, and the panel does not add them together. Zema and Haddad remain below the 0.5% cutoff and therefore receive no new reading. Zema is the only one in the pack with a registration already filed with the TSE, done on Aug 6, and for that reason the Aug 15 deadline does not press him.

cruzamento: THE DAY HAD A NEW PRICE AND AN INSTITUTIONAL FACT, AND THE TWO POINT IN DIFFERENT DIRECTIONS. On price, the reading of Aug 14 confirms a presidential book that is practically still: the leader at 63.50% for the sixth consecutive day in the recorded series, the runner-up rising 0.20pp to 27.85%, Renan Santos falling 0.30pp to 7.15% and Caiado rising 0.10pp to 1.05%. The distance between the top two narrowed by 0.20pp, from 35.85pp to 35.65pp, and all of the movement came from the runner-up, not from the leader. ⛔ No superlative: the series recorded since May 16 shows 51 points with the runner-up at a level equal to or above today's, and his peak remains 33.20%, from Jun 2. Outside the presidential book there is no new reading on Aug 14, and the second and third place contracts, the Senate one and the STF impeachment one all keep the values of the confirmed reading of Aug 12. In the polls there was no news either: Quaest releases a national poll today with 13 candidates tested, and at the time of this capture the results had not yet been published, so the national poll in force remains PoderData/Aya of Aug 13. ⭐ WHAT REALLY CHANGED TODAY WAS THE ELECTORAL REGISTRY, AND IT IS THE BIGGEST INSTITUTIONAL FACT OF THE WINDOW. On the night of Aug 13 the TSE suspended the processing of new affiliations in the Filia system, after the improper inclusion of the runner-up in Missão and an attempt to change the leader's affiliation that was never completed, according to Gazeta do Povo and Brasil de Fato. ⚠️ The court itself stated that there was NO hacking, but rather improper use of the tool by someone holding the party's credentials, which is a relevant distinction and not a detail. On Aug 13 Nunes Marques restored the PL affiliation and cleared the registration, and the runner-up's presidential candidacy was registered hours later, according to Brasil de Fato on Aug 14. The candidate registration deadline closes on Aug 15, which means the suspension of the system lands on the eve of the cutoff, and from Aug 16 the absence of a registration stops being a pending matter and becomes a fact. ⚠️ The panel records the order of events and does not attribute cause: the runner-up's price rose 0.20pp in the same window in which his records obstacle was removed, and that is a calendar coincidence, not a measured relationship. A third fact entered today and has no counterpart in the price: the OAS announced on Aug 13 that it will send an electoral observation mission to Brazil, headed by José Miguel Insulza, a former foreign minister of Chile and former Secretary General of the OAS itself, according to CNN Brasil and Gazeta do Povo. It is the fifth OAS mission in Brazil since 2018.
